entities.summary:
Artabazanes of Media Atropatene was a Prince and King of the Atropatene Kingdom, ruling from 221 BC or 220 BC.

He was a contemporary of the Seleucid Greek King Antiochus III the Great, with whom he likely clashed due to their competing territorial claims.

Artabazanes' reign was marked by his efforts to strengthen the Atropatene Kingdom, which had previously been a tributary state to the Achaemenid Empire.

His legacy was largely overshadowed by the rise of the Seleucid Empire, but he remains an important figure in the history of the region.

The inscription on his tombstone, now lost, was said to have been a significant work of art, rivaling that of his contemporaries in terms of its grandeur and historical significance.
